description: Complete 14-cell differential with all precursors and mature cell lines. Default for comprehensive bone marrow and peripheral blood analysis. Left-hand ergonomic key layout.

provenance.citation: Lee S-H, Erber WN, Porwit A, Tomonaga M, Peterson LC, for the ICSH. ICSH guidelines for the standardization of bone marrow specimens and reports. Int J Lab Hematol 2008;30(5):349-364.
provenance.notes: Bone marrow categories and M:E ratio follow ICSH 2008 §2.6.

ME_ratio.label: M:E Ratio
ME_ratio.basis: ICSH 2008 §2.6: all granulocytes and monocytes and their precursors (myeloblasts, promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, band forms, segmented neutrophils, eosinophils, basophils, promonocytes, monocytes) over erythroblasts at all stages. Note that a competing convention excludes monocytes.

categoryNotes.other: Unclassifiable haemopoietic cells only. Do NOT count into this category: megakaryocytes, macrophages, osteoblasts, osteoclasts, stromal cells, smudged cells, or non-haemopoietic cells such as metastatic tumour cells — ICSH 2008 §2.6 excludes these from the nucleated differential count. Record such findings in the morphology comment instead.

thresholds.label: AML blast threshold
thresholds.basis: WHO 2022 / ICC 2022 — 20% blasts of all nucleated cells.

thresholds.label: low blast threshold
thresholds.basis: ICSH 2008 §2.6 cites 5% as a low threshold warranting an extended count.

thresholds.label: plasma cell threshold
thresholds.basis: 10% clonal plasma cells is a diagnostic boundary for plasma cell neoplasia.

specimenTypes.targetCountBasis: ICSH 2008 §2.6: at least 500 cells when a precise percentage of an abnormal cell type is required for diagnosis; at least 300 when the differential is not essential to it.
